subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Which permanent hard-budget units and exhaustion behavior should OpenClaw expose for agent runs before the linked implementation proceeds?
rationale: This adds public configuration and runtime semantics, while current source does not determine whether turns, individual calls, elapsed time, forced summarization, or abrupt termination is the intended contract.

options.title: Single iteration budget
options.body: Expose one opt-in model-to-tool round cap with a tool-free final-summary grace turn and separate parent/subagent values.

options.title: Separate hard budgets
options.body: Expose distinct turn, total-tool-call, and elapsed-time caps with explicit precedence and exhaustion behavior for each.

options.title: Heuristic guards only
options.body: Keep hard count budgets out of core and improve loop detection and whole-run timeout behavior instead.

recommendation.title: Single iteration budget
recommendation.body: Expose one opt-in model-to-tool round cap with a tool-free final-summary grace turn and separate parent/subagent values.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans loop detection, agent-core behavior, and the prior product/API review of this issue.
